# Chimera II OS generated image assets

This catalog records the generated visual assets identified in the ChatGPT project workspace as relevant to Chimera II OS and its supporting architecture/research work.

> Binary note: the current GitHub connector available to this session can create/update text content and Git blobs, but it does not provide a direct conversation-file-to-GitHub binary upload operation. The catalog is therefore committed now; the original binary images remain in the project file library until a binary-capable upload path is used.
